rules: S-A gets a 5x5 landing + 1:12 switchback ramp that runs EAST along the south wall and returns to grade (Rev 4.3/4.4 A-403) - needs ~18 ft east of the unit and ~9.6 ft in front; keep the meter / inlet / EV clear zone free.
D2-K has a second door on the back wall: rows of D2-K need a 6.75 ft access zone on both sides.
Accessible units (clusters): max(1, 5% of units) S-A, roll-in (Concept Notes Rev 3 §5.5 - VERIFY).
Every door and stair faces the shared lane / courtyard; rows mirror door-to-door (render reference R-301).
Unit spacing default 6 ft and lane 20 ft are editable placeholders - VERIFY fire separation and access per AHJ.
